description: The DevInit file points to the official schema at https://json.schemastore.org/devinit.schema-4.0.json and is intended as a DevInit configuration for setting up a typical web dev container. It defines three sequential actions. First, the **apt-get-install** tool will be run with the input “git” and the additional option “-y” to install Git via apt without prompting. The accompanying comment reads “Install Git via apt”. Next, the **require-nodejs** tool is invoked to ensure that Node.js is available; no input or extra options are required, and its comment states “Ensure Node.js is available”. Finally, the **set-env** tool sets the environment variable `NODE_ENV=development`; there are no extra options, and the comment notes “Set development environment variable”.

reference_json.comments: DevInit configuration for setting up a typical web dev container
